claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lamp for fitting all five fingers at once, saving time versus smaller lamps.
Many customers say it saves money versus salon visits and works well for at-home gel nails.
Several reviewers note curing takes longer than expected, often requiring multiple timer cycles.
Some reviewers received defective units, but seller customer service sent free replacements quickly.
A few reviewers mention bulbs came disconnected during shipping but were easy to reconnect.
